scripts.get-sops: wget https://github.com/getsops/sops/releases/download/v3.13.3/sops-v3.13.3.linux.amd64 -O ./sops && echo 'e5bec3346a873ae91d871550f3e698c1aad962aff462a080e40f25fde17fef6b  sops' | sha256sum -c - && chmod a+x ./sops
scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run -- tsc --outDir build/ --declaration false && npm run get-sops && cp -R ./sops ./build/
scripts.quick-compile: npm run -- tsc --outDir build/ --declaration false && ([[ -f ./sops ]] || npm run get-sops) && cp ./sops ./build/
